Section 2.6.2 sentence comparing the symmetric- and antisymmetric-stretch frequencies for M>2m
contents.reason: The eigenvalues computed from the matrices printed in the same section give the opposite ordering (omega_3>omega_2 for all M>0), and the reader record already flags the sentence as a source error; the example proves the correct comparison from the displayed matrices and does not reproduce the erroneous sentence.
